document_types.invoice: A bill requesting payment for delivered goods or services; excludes quotes and paid receipts.
document_types.receipt: Confirms a completed payment or purchase, with no remaining payment requested.
document_types.statement: Periodic financial account activity or balance summary, such as a bank statement.
document_types.policy: An insurance policy or coverage declaration.
document_types.tax_document: An official tax reporting form or tax filing document.
document_types.contract: An agreement specifying obligations between parties, including leases and employment agreements.
document_types.manual: Instructions for operating, maintaining, or assembling a product.
document_types.letter: General correspondence or a notice that does not primarily fit a more specific listed type.
document_types.unknown: None of the listed types fits, or the text is too incomplete to determine its primary purpose.

tags.utilities: Household electricity, natural gas, water, or sewer service accounts or usage. Excludes product power requirements.
tags.electricity: Electric utility supply, billing, or metered household power usage. Excludes electrical appliance instructions.
tags.water: Household water supply, billing, or metered usage. Excludes incidental water references.
tags.banking: Bank account balances, deposits, withdrawals, or financial account statements. A payment instruction alone does not count.
tags.insurance: Insurance coverage, premiums, policies, or claim benefits. Incidental advertising and footer mentions do not count.
tags.medical: Healthcare, clinical services, appointments, or health benefit claims.
tags.tax: Official tax reporting, returns, or tax obligations. Sales tax on an ordinary bill does not count.
tags.vehicle: Vehicle ownership, repair, maintenance, or vehicle insurance. Incidental car mentions do not count.
tags.solar: Residential solar generation, equipment, installation, or solar energy agreements.
tags.employment: Employment terms, wages, payroll, or employer-employee agreements.
tags.housing: Residential property leases, rent, purchase, or home insurance. Utility service alone does not count.
tags.appliances: Household appliance purchases, repair, or operating instructions.
